description: This file defines functions for building and initializing AI agents, retrieving their tools, and executing tools within a Flowise server environment. It interacts with database entities, constructs graphs, resolves variables, and manages external tool calls.

methods.name: buildAndInitTool
methods.description: Builds and initializes an AI agent based on chatflow ID, optionally with specific chat ID and API message ID.

methods.name: getAgentTools
methods.description: Retrieves the list of tools available for a specific chatflow agent.

methods.name: executeAgentTool
methods.description: Executes a specified tool of an agent within a chatflow, processing input arguments and parsing output for source documents, artifacts, and tool output.
